text.name: TextDesc2
text.text: The Sharp X1 was a Japanese home computer series released in 1982. It was designed with strong graphics capabilities and became known for its use in games, programming, and multimedia applications. The system used a Z80 processor and featured hardware that allowed detailed graphics compared with many competing home computers of the period. Its software library included arcade-style games, adventure games, and utilities. The X1 line was later replaced by Sharp's X68000 computers.
